push.title: W 3-2 vs West Ohio Albon | You: 8.2
push.body:
Good stuff, BellyTb1. An 8.2 against West Ohio Albon. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.

THE GOOD
+ 93% passing on 27 attempts, up from your usual 76%. Simple, smart and successful. My three favorite S's.
+ A goal against West Ohio Albon. The net said thank you, and so do I.
+ 1 key pass. You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ Every time you found buddskees, something good happened.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.

THE BAD
- Tackles won 0, down from your usual 1. Think about this: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
- Shots 1, down from your usual 2. Little homework: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.

Practice prescription: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

BellyTb1, from me to you: The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

Keep your chin up and your effort higher. - Coach Lasso

Last thing, PhogsToffees. The ball is round, the game is long, and you're doing just fine.

Hard days make strong players. - Coach Lasso
